dataset.title: Sources
dataset.description: Registry of every source the OS cites. Evidence and provenance reference these ids.

records.name: The Complete Laser Handbook
records.description: From Photon to Industrial Laser Systems, Processes, Machines & End-Product Applications. 28 parts.
records.author: Jatin Songara — Laser and Photonics Vertical, Titan Engineering and Automation Ltd.

records.name: Automation Equipment Building Handbook
records.description: From customer requirement to machine architecture, engineering, manufacturing, FAT, SAT and production. Edition 1.0; 60 parts, 12 books, 10 case studies, 11 design-review gates, 177 formulas.
records.author: Jatin Songara — Project Manager, Laser & Photonics Vertical, TEAL

records.name: The Complete Semiconductor Industry Handbook
records.description: From Silicon to Chips to Systems to Everything.
records.author: Jatin Songara — Laser & Photonics Vertical, Titan Engineering & Automation Ltd.

records.name: Legacy TEAL Laser Equipment Configurator (data.json)
records.description: Value store of the legacy configurator (_updated 2026-08-02). Its README states the configuration data is derived from "TEAL Laser Automation Solutions — Product Catalogue, 2026 Edition (Ch. 02–13)" and that prices are indicative ex-works estimates from a parametric model, not quotations.

records.name: TEAL Laser Automation Solutions — Product Catalogue, 2026 Edition
records.description: Referenced by the legacy configurator as the origin of its platform data. The catalogue itself is not in this repository.

provenance.note: Document not available to the OS; cited second-hand via the legacy configurator.

records.name: Legacy TEAL Costing & Estimation Platform (data/*.json)
records.description: Seed masters of the legacy cost platform. Mixes real company names with fabricated demonstration records (e.g. items attributed to vendors that do not make them). Treated as DEMO.

records.name: Legacy Laser Applications PM Operating Tracker (js/schema.js)
records.description: Controlled vocabularies and entity definitions of the legacy product-management tracker.

records.name: TEAL Engineering Intelligence OS — Final Master Build Specification (GitHub-only V1)
records.description: The build specification for this platform. Source of module lists, workflows and enumerations (e.g. application industries, laser categories, radar statuses).
